title: Orano
summary: French nuclear-fuel-cycle group covering mining, conversion and enrichment.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Orano mines uranium, converts and enriches it, and handles fuel fabrication and recycling. Its enrichment and recycling capacity make it one of the few non-Russian fuel-cycle suppliers in the West. The company is state-controlled and central to European fuel-security policy.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium mining
  • Conversion and enrichment
  • Fuel recycling

What To Watch

  • Enrichment capacity expansion
  • European fuel-security policy
  • Mining project performance

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
